title: Every menu on the controller
text: Every button on every screen can be reached with the d-pad, including the Quality setting. The first press only shows where you are, Options also unpauses, and the results table fits on a phone.

title: Play with a controller
text: The whole game plays on a controller, from the menu to the victory screen: move and aim with the sticks, fire with R2, abilities on L1, R1 and triangle, and the d-pad switches plants and picks boons. Button hints change to match whatever you last touched, and the HUD grows on a big screen.

title: A cleaner screen
text: The HUD and the menus are redrawn: what you need shows up when it matters and gets out of the way when it doesn't. The frame counter is always on.

title: Boons and mutators
text: Between waves you pick one of three boons for the squad, and every match rolls its own wave mutators: tougher, faster, more or harder-hitting zombies.

title: A field guide
text: New players get a field guide to the plants, the zombies and the statue. Big hordes run smoother, and the game tells you when it can't take the mouse.

title: Watch your squad
text: When you're down you watch a teammate through their own camera and HUD until you're back. The camera no longer goes through walls and cover, and zombies find their way round ramps, ledges and cliffs.

title: Rebalanced
text: Every plant is rebalanced, Citron's beam has no range limit, and the zombie waves are easier. Coins, potted plants and statue repairs are gone.

title: Citron, Rose and Chomper
text: Three new plants join the squad. Matches have objectives, the plant you play earns mastery, your companions are picked at random without repeats, and the sound starts at half volume.

title: A garden worth defending
text: New world art round a gnome statue, a radar, arcs that show where hits come from, and a better first match for new players. Every enemy is retuned against the plants, and companions fight smarter.

title: The boss slot machine
text: Waves 5 and 10 spin a slot machine for their boss, and the match ends with an extraction you have to survive.

title: Stats and difficulty
text: Match stats, a summary after every wave, settings in the pause menu and difficulty presets. Zombies drop coins for potted plants and statue repairs.

title: A livelier horde
text: The horde is sculpted and fully animated: zombies flinch, topple and pop out of the ground. Packs come from random spawn points along routes they plan themselves, and it all runs without stutter.

title: Zombie agents
text: The Scientist, the Imp in his Z-Mech, the Engineer and Super Brainz escort the packs with their own weapons and tricks. Bosses hunt your heroes, the Cactus can fortify, and the squad bar shows when everyone respawns.

title: Sound
text: Every shot, step and kill has its sound, with a chime that climbs during a streak. The game goes quiet when you pause or switch away, and the early waves come faster.

title: Squad up
text: An AI teammate fights beside you and can revive you when you're down. The map is bigger, with two routes from every spawn and a warning before each wave, and you can sprint.

title: The first garden
text: Kernel Corn holds the garden against ten waves of zombies, Climbers, Howlers, Burrowers and their bosses, across lanes and high ground.
